compiled_state.description:
## Context
ADR 0043 defines exactly two completion-evidence kinds: untagged acceptance criteria are codebase-verifiable, while criteria whose evidence inherently lives outside the repository must use the exact `[operator-attested]` tag. The current P6 deterministic lexicon only coaches on a subset of untagged operational phrases and cannot semantically inspect every criterion or detect an incorrectly applied tag. A1 `f7ee-572b-1eb0-4af8` demonstrated the gap: plan review passed a repo-level benchmark criterion without the required tag, then completion verification failed after the work was already merged.

## Approach
- Add an explicit plan-review criterion that evaluates every acceptance-criterion checkbox independently and classifies where its completion evidence can truthfully be verified.
- Preserve ADR 0043 fail-safe semantics: untagged and malformed tags remain codebase-verifiable; only the exact case-insensitive `[operator-attested]` token selects ticket-attestation evidence.
- Find both error directions: externally verifiable criteria missing the exact tag, and codebase-verifiable criteria incorrectly tagged operator-attested (which would weaken completion proof to a comment).
- Require evidence specific to the criterion, not keyword-only classification. Reuse the existing deterministic detector as candidate/coverage input where useful, but keep semantic judgment in the new criterion and leave the P6 lexicon fail-open/advisory.
- Route and document the criterion through the canonical registry, reviewer prompt/contract, criteria routing, generated criteria guide, and frozen evaluation corpus.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The new plan-review criterion visits every `- [ ]` / `- [x]` acceptance item and returns one of two evidence kinds, `codebase-verifiable` or `operator-attested`, with criterion-specific evidence for the classification. Tier: reviewer contract/unit test plus behavioral eval.
- [ ] An inherently external criterion with no tag or a malformed near-miss produces a finding whose remediation names the exact `- [ ] [operator-attested] …` syntax; an exact tag on an external criterion is accepted. Tier: prompt-contract fixtures and behavioral eval.
- [ ] A codebase-verifiable criterion carrying `[operator-attested]` produces a finding explaining that ticket comments cannot substitute for repository proof; the same criterion untagged is accepted. Tier: prompt-contract fixtures and behavioral eval.
- [ ] A criterion that bundles repository proof and outside-world proof is not silently assigned one evidence kind: review tells the author to split it into independently certifiable criteria. Tier: behavioral eval with a mixed-evidence fixture.
- [ ] High-confidence misclassification findings participate in the normal validity × impact blocking policy, while deterministic keyword detection remains advisory/fail-open and records abstentions. Tier: policy/registry unit tests.
- [ ] Registry completeness, criteria routing, reviewer resources, generated `docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md`, and author guidance describe the new check and ADR 0043 exact-tag semantics without drift. Verify with the repository generation/drift gates.
- [ ] [operator-attested] A pinned multi-sample before/after evaluation over a frozen corpus that includes A1, the historical 115b/8c4f cases, codebase negatives, malformed tags, over-tagged code criteria, and mixed-evidence items meets these predeclared thresholds: 100% precision (zero false positives) on the genuine-external negative set; 100% recall on the named A1, 115b/8c4f, malformed-tag, and over-tagged-code fixtures; macro precision and recall ≥ 0.90 across the full frozen corpus; and no previously passing fixture regresses; record model/config, sample counts, per-class results, and the run artifact on this ticket.
      provenance: environment=rebar plan-review production-equivalent workflow at the ticket verified_at_sha; principal=bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — the frozen corpus runs through the same signed plan-review workflow and model/runtime configuration used by this repository gate
- [ ] `make lint`, `make typecheck`, and `make test` pass, including focused tests proving the completion verifier still treats untagged criteria as codebase-verifiable and exact-tag criteria as operator-attested.

## Scope
Plan-review criterion and its tests/eval/documentation only. Do not broaden the completion verifier’s trust boundary or add external-service access.
